value.rationale: Exact-multiplicity scattered-pattern recognition is a natural refinement of existence testing and a direct automaton-state minimization problem. The theorem gives the complete quotient structure and sharp quadratic state formula, including the non-obvious collapse of many counter states to one-one quotients. These structural results are not implied by fixed-length frequency counts or existing existential pattern-complexity bounds.
